policy_evidence.cw-returns:
# Cartwheel return policy

Items bought on Cartwheel can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The window counts from the delivery date, not the purchase date. Items must be in the condition described by the store's listing. Individual stores may override this window; see the store overrides policy and the store's own policy page.
policy_evidence.store-meridian-cycles-policy:
# Meridian Cycles store policy

Meridian Cycles accepts returns within 21 days of delivery, instead of the Cartwheel platform default of 30 days. This store window takes precedence for all Meridian Cycles orders.
policy_evidence.cw-refunds:
# Cartwheel refund policy

Approved refunds go back to the original payment method and arrive in 5 to 10 business days. Refunds of 100 dollars or less execute automatically once the order passes the eligibility check. Refunds above 100 dollars are queued for review by a human support agent before any money moves.

# Cartwheel order cancellation policy

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.
